name: hmi_import_json
description: Upsert a versioned Unified HMI JSON directory or staged transfer under an Openness transaction, verify it, compile, and never save the project. An item without a text, dynamizations or events key keeps those sections unchanged; an empty list removes all dynamizations or events. Existing Singlebit/Bitmask mapping tables are updated in place; a changed condition type or bit layout needs onConflict 'replace' on that dynamization (only the dynamization is recreated); bitmask entries must stay in TIA's exported order. A dry run reports these mapping-table refusals. Flags enum properties such as WindowFlags take one name or names separated by ',' or '|', or 'None'. Script read-back ignores line endings and trailing whitespace. Import never reorders existing screen items: manifest or screen zOrder 'keep' (default) reports order differences in zOrderWarnings, 'require' fails and rolls back.

input_directory.description: Server-local directory containing manifest.json and referenced files. Use this or transfer_id, not both.

transfer_id.description: Staged import ID returned by hmi_begin_import. Use this or input_directory, not both.

prune_items.description: Delete screen items absent from imported screen files (default: false).

dry_run.description: Validate the files and target without making changes (default: false).

verify_hashes.description: Verify exported file hashes (default: true). Set false only when intentionally editing exported JSON without refreshing manifest hashes.

target_name.description: Target HMI software/device selector (optional when only one target exists).
